content.description: Multiple Peakboard projects can now be opened as tabs within a single Peakboard Designer window.
The new Step Control displays 3D CAD models directly inside your Peakboard project.
The Data Debugger in the Box Management dialog allows you to remotely debug the data of a Peakboard Box.
Datepicker and Timepicker have been revised – including icon color and output language in conditional formatting as well as an adjusted popup.
Hold the Alt key to move a control or a group along the Z-index using a slider.

list_items: Added the option to convert related controls into each other via the context menu (e.g. linear gauge to circular gauge).
Added the possibility to set the opacity for gradients.
Added a drag & drop preview that shows a real control instead of a plain cursor when adding controls to the canvas.
Added a slider to reposition a control or group in the Z-index when Alt is pressed.
Added the possibility to open several Peakboard projects as tabs instead of multiple Peakboard Designer windows.
Added a download progress bar to the 'Updating designer' dialog.
Added German template descriptions when the Peakboard Designer language is set to German.
Closing the loading window now stops loading the Peakboard Designer.
Fixed clipboard access.
Fixed color picker: selecting a color after transparent now applies the color with full alpha.
Fixed missing background for some textboxes and dropdowns.
Fixed missing BACnet data source in the search.
Fixed crash when changing the 'used in scripting' setting a second time.
Fixed drag & drop menu for charts.
Added the data debugger to the Box Management dialog for remote debugging.
Added a description for the new password policy.
Added automatic reconnection of the cloud connection when the service bus returns a 404 error.
Fixed error messages when uploading a large project via cloud.
Fixed Peakboard Designer access to a Peakboard Box after its IP changed while an outdated DNS entry is stored.
Fixed multi selection mode staying active after deleting all Peakboard Boxes.
The Peakboard hub box group is synchronised in the Box Management dialogue.
Updated the wording in the Peakboard Hub connection dialog.
Added the possibility to store a flow project as a new instance.
Added the name validation textbox, matching the data source dialogs.
Added a hub user field to the global function call so the email of the calling user is available in scripts and Building Blocks.
Unzipped project files are now stored in the Peakboard folder instead of the global temp folder.
Added a new option to save files in a network folder based on a Base64 string.
Resources in the web access are now sorted alphabetically.
Fixed error in the data binding dialog when adding a Peakboard Hub resource with the same name as a local resource.
Fixed unclear error message when selecting a folder instead of a file for a SharePoint resource.
Fixed loading of videos from SharePoint resources.
The settings tab now stays selected when switching between chart series.
Fixed X and Y column selection when changing the source of a chart.
Fixed bar chart spacing property being reset to 'Default' when opening the chart dialog.
Fixed an issue with decimal values in gauges and charts.
Added a dropdown to select the active application in the debug screen.
Added the current license type to the info panel.
Fixed renaming of component instances.
Fixed duplicate control names when adding a component instance via the toolbar.
Added gradients to the button background setting.
Fixed icon position 'top' not being stored.
Fixed buttons keeping their hover state.
Fixed padding and thickness editor for button, checkbox and radio button.
Added corner radius for each item of the styled tile and styled list template.
Improved the styled list editor with layer rearranging via drag & drop, grouping and several editor refinements.
Fixed the issue where spacing was lost.
Fixed floating tiles when resizing the width of a styled tile collection.
Added support for line breaks in texts using \n.
Improved webbrowser performance.
Improved performance of webbrowser and PDF controls on screens that are not currently shown.
Fixed making an invisible webpage control visible.
Added buttons to copy and paste data bindings in the binding popup.
Added a searchable dropdown for the font selection.
Icons for corner radius and borders have been added to the Multi-Editor.
Fixed color picker so the color is applied when pressing Enter.
Added a property for the icon colour in conditional formatting.
Added a format for the output language in conditional formatting.
Aligned the popup corner radius and added a 5px spacing between picker and popup.
Fixed transparent background and border colors.
Fixed tabbing to the next element.
Reworked the variable list table with a new control, including drag & drop reordering, keyboard navigation, empty state and a refreshed design.
Added the variable type to the response of ApiGetVariables.
Fixed error when adding an empty row to a variable list with a number column.
Fixed exception when adding a string column with a values constraint.
Added a new step to calculate the time difference from the current row to the previous one.
Added a filter for a column value to the accumulate step.
Added a confirmation dialog when deleting a dataflow step.
'Ignore time' is now an individual setting for each date/time filter.
Fixed deleting a dataflow that has a script reference to itself.
Fixed missing error in the dataflow dialog when referencing a non-existing index in a dataflow script.
Scrollable tables now scroll only the rows, the header stays in place.
Fixed table being cut at the bottom when 'Max rows' is smaller than the data.
Added a folder selection dialog for the 'Upload to Peakboard Hub' Building Block, including creating new folders.
Added the possibility to upload a Base64 file to Peakboard Hub, SharePoint and OneDrive.
Added multiple search parameters and a column type check to the find Building Blocks (index of, last index of, contains).
The 'Add list' Building Block no longer transfers data if the column data types do not match and writes a log entry.
Fixed error in the 'Add list' Building Block when the list rows exceed the 'Max rows' value of the connected table control.
Fixed dropdown selection being reset when deleting a Building Block with the Backspace key.
Fixed writing into a SharePoint list so an empty number field keeps the existing value.
When opening a package, you are asked whether any missing extensions that are available online should be installed.
You are now asked whether any missing extensions included in the package should be installed.
Fixed missing rounded corners in extension data source dialogs.
A new data source for network files has been added.
Fixed the 'Reload of data source failed' event.
Fixed project being marked as modified when cancelling a variable, data source or dataflow dialog.
Added the folder structure columns (FileRef, FileDirRef, IsFolder) to the SharePoint library data source.
Fixed the Office 365 calendar data source returning a maximum of 50 events and a wrong subset when filtering by timeframe.
Fixed apostrophes in Excel column names, which are now replaced while loading the data.
Reworked the script editor with a new modular architecture and a completely refreshed user interface.
Fixed Lua grammar marking multiline strings starting with [=[[ as invalid.
Fixed recognition of escaped characters.
Optimised the search tags for the floppy disk, delete and garbage can icons.
Fixed missing tags and descriptions for some data sources.
Fixed moving multiple selected controls into a folder via drag & drop.
Long column names are now shown in full on hover in the signal lamp rules dialog.
Selecting nothing is now possible if the bound value is not part of the bound list.
Copying conditional formatting between different control types is now possible if the properties match.
Gradients have been removed as the background for the drawing area.
Added the possibility to rename fonts.
Added a Step (3D CAD) control.
Fixed exception in the auto save when a rich text control has no resource.
Fixed crash when changing a PDF rapidly.
Fixed loading of the Power BI control in the Peakboard Runtime.
Fixed scaling of the slider for different resolutions.
Fixed disappearing logs when detaching the log section.
Window mode and minimising are no longer available when the runtime is running on a Peakboard Box.
Moved the Peakboard Edge icon from the top bar to the home screen.
